Container.Name: cals-dev-identity
Container.Overview: DEV-ONLY, LAN-ONLY cals container for testing as either household user. Runs the same image as cals-dev-v2 with DEV_MODE=true and DEV_IDENTITY_SWITCH=true, host networking, and its own COPY of the database at /mnt/user/appdata/cals-dev-identity. Open http://[Unraid LAN IP]:8152/dev/identity to switch identity, or ?as=email to override once. Never expose through Cloudflare Tunnel; never mount production appdata. See docs/architecture/dev-identity-switch.md and docs/architecture/data-copy-warning.md.
Container.Description: Cals DEV identity-switch container (LAN only, disposable data copy).

Config.Name: Port
Config.Description: Port the app listens on. Host networking, so this must be free on the Unraid host (V1 uses 8150, V2 uses 8151).

Config.Name: Bind address (Unraid LAN IP)
Config.Description: REQUIRED. The Unraid host's LAN IP, e.g. 192.168.1.10. DEV_MODE rejects 0.0.0.0, ::, hostnames and public addresses.

Config.Name: Dev mode
Config.Description: Enables local development auth (loopback/private peers only). Do not change.

Config.Name: Dev identity switch
Config.Description: Enables /dev/identity and ?as=email identity switching. Requires DEV_MODE=true and never works on the Cloudflare-routed container. Do not change.

Config.Name: Default dev user email
Config.Description: The identity used before a user is picked, e.g. you@example.com. The user must exist in the copy; the switch only lists existing users.

Config.Name: Dev appdata (disposable data copy)
Config.Description: A COPY of the database, made with the source container stopped. Never point this at V1 (/mnt/user/appdata/cals) or the live V2 appdata (/mnt/user/appdata/cals-dev-v2).
